events.text: Far from any road you come to a palace of blue ice at the head of a frozen valley, its gate a single slab of glacier. This is the Northern Ice Palace, one of the elemental halls that keep the Ice arts. Palace Mistress Baek Sorin comes to the gate, looks at you for a long time, and says your root has been heard from a long way off.

choices.text: Kneel at the gate and ask to be taught

ok.log: Palace Mistress Baek Sorin teaches you the first art of the hall in person, from dawn to dark, until your root answers it without being asked.

fail.log: You kneel until the snow, the rain or the sun has had enough of you. The gate stays shut. Perhaps another year.

choices.text: Stand in the frozen pool until she says stop

ok.log: You stop feeling your feet, then your knees, then the cold itself. When she says stop the water has frozen around you and the disciples have to chip you out. You are taught the Frost Lotus Palm.

fail.log: You last longer than most and not as long as you needed to. They carry you to a bed and send you away with a bowl of soup.

choices.text: Bow and go on your way

effects.log: You bow to the gate. Some arts wait for you; some do not. You will not know which this was.

events.text: You come back to the Northern Ice Palace. Palace Mistress Baek Sorin has been expecting you, and has a question: whether your root is truly Ice, all the way down, because the secret of the hall, the Thousand-Winter Glacier Sword, is taught to nothing else.

choices.text: Take the hall's test of the secret

ok.log: The test lasts three days and you remember none of it clearly. On the fourth morning you are shown the Thousand-Winter Glacier Sword, one form at a time, and it fits your root like a hand in a glove.

fail.log: The test finds the place where your root and your art still pull apart. You are sent away to close it, kindly, and with a cough of blood.

choices.text: Ask to stay a season and learn the hall's ways first

effects.log: A season of sweeping, listening and cold rice. You leave with nothing written down and a great deal understood.

choices.text: Thank them, and decline

effects.log: You decline. The master does not seem surprised, or sorry.

events.text: "Your root is Water," the Palace Mistress says, "and water that is cold enough for long enough is not water any more." She points at the black pool under the ice, where the Palace sends a disciple once in a generation. A root turned this way is a mutated root, and it does not turn back.

choices.text: Go down into the black pool

ok.log: The cold goes past the skin and the bone and into the root itself. When they pull you out your qi has turned white and still, like a winter lake at night.

fail.log: It goes wrong, the way the master warned it might. You live, and your root is what it was, and for a month you shake.

choices.text: Keep the root you were born with

effects.log: You keep what you were born with. The master shrugs: not everyone wants to be rare.
